attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0004: A close downward amateur smartphone photograph of an overwhelmed rectangular roadside storm-drain grate in a residential street in Kennedy, Bogotá, Colombia. Shallow murky rainwater spreads around the drain over rough asphalt, with a few leaves and curb stones, rain ripples. One mustard-yellow wall and grey metal garage gate partly seen at top. No people, no dramatic waves. This is a complaint documenting drainage failing during heavy rain.
